newsitem.title: USA: NAM says signs Royal Insurance contract.
newsitem.headline: NAM says signs Royal Insurance contract.

text.p: NAM Corp said it has signed an agreement with Royal Insurance Plc that establishes NAM as Royal's preferred alternative dispute resolution provider on a nationwide basis.
NAM said the agreement provides it will conduct a minimum number of arbitrations and/or mediations on a yearly basis for Royal's branches throughout the country.
Roy Israel, president of NAM, said, "This contract will broaden the extent of our services on a nationwide level."
NAM Corp provides alternative dispute resolution services principally to insurance companies, law firms, corporations and municipalities.
